verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Incident Workflows and Event Orchestration explicitly support configurable 'if-this-then-that' triggers/actions on incidents and events (auto-trigger for P1/P2, dedup/suppress alerts, escalation policies notifying on-call chains), and this automation is exposed via Events API, REST API, webhooks, and an official MCP server for AI-agent integration. Community evidence corroborates escalation policies working reliably in practice (comm-1), though some report friction with configuration and API versioning (comm-4, comm-6). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of Incident Workflow/Orchestration rule automation (vs. just escalation) and confirmation that AI agents can programmatically define these rules via MCP rather than just fetch/manage data.
